name: diya-flame
brief: A single small oil-lamp flame effect sprite for a clay diya, with nothing else: an upright teardrop candle flame, rounded base at the bottom and one pointed tip at the top leaning very slightly right. Three flat colour bands from inside out: a small white-yellow hot core low in the flame, bright marigold-yellow body, deep orange outer edge with a thin red-orange rim. No dark outline, no wick, no lamp, no smoke, no sparks, no glow halo, no rays. About 14 pixels wide and 28 pixels tall.
subject: prop
